days.desc: Understand ethical hacking phases: Recon, Scanning, Exploitation, Post-Exploitation.
checklist: Understand the legal and ethical boundaries of penetration testing
Understand common exploit terminology: payload, exploit, meterpreter, shellcode
Explore TryHackMe or HackTheBox free starter tracks

days.phaseName: Incident Response, Threat Hunting & Hands-on Labs
days.title: Web Application Security: OWASP Top 10
days.desc: Understand core web vulnerabilities: SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, Broken Access Control.
checklist: Understand SQL Injection (SQLi) and how prepared statements prevent it
Understand Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and Content Security Policy (CSP)
Understand Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in cloud environments

days.phaseName: Incident Response, Threat Hunting & Hands-on Labs
days.title: Backup & Disaster Recovery Strategy
days.desc: Implement the 3-2-1 backup rule, encrypted offsite backups, and recovery testing.
days.cmd:
cat << 'EOF'
3 Copies of data
2 Different media types
1 Offsite backup
EOF

commands.cmd:
cat << 'EOF'
3 Copies of data
2 Different media types
1 Offsite backup
EOF

checklist: Design a resilient backup strategy following the 3-2-1 rule
Encrypt backup archives with GPG or Age before cloud storage
Perform a test restore drills to verify backup archive integrity

days.phaseName: Incident Response, Threat Hunting & Hands-on Labs
days.title: Security Incident Response Playbook
days.desc: Walk through incident handling phases: Preparation, Detection, Containment, Eradication, Recovery.
checklist: Step 1: Isolate compromised host from network (ip link set dev down)
Step 2: Collect volatile forensic memory and state before reboot
Step 3: Identify entry vector and patch root cause before restoring

days.phaseName: Incident Response, Threat Hunting & Hands-on Labs
days.title: SELinux & Advanced Mandatory Access Control
days.desc: Understand Security-Enhanced Linux (SELinux) contexts, policies, and booleans.
checklist: Understand SELinux components: User, Role, Type, Level
Understand enforcing vs permissive modes
Troubleshoot access denial using audit logs and setroubleshoot

days.phaseName: Incident Response, Threat Hunting & Hands-on Labs
days.title: Automated Vulnerability Scanning (OpenVAS / Nuclei)
days.desc: Use vulnerability scanners to identify CVEs, outdated packages, and misconfigurations.
checklist: Understand Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) and CVSS scores
Review vulnerability report outputs and prioritize critical/high risks
Distinguish automated scanner false positives from real exploits

days.phaseName: Incident Response, Threat Hunting & Hands-on Labs
days.title: Career Paths & Certifications in SysAdmin & CyberSec
days.desc: Plan certification roadmaps (CompTIA Security+, RHCSA, CEH, OSCP, eJPT).
checklist: Explore SysAdmin paths: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), Linux Foundation (LFCS)
Explore Defensive (Blue Team) paths: Security+, CySA+, BTL1
Explore Offensive (Red Team) paths: eJPT, PNPT, OSCP

days.phaseName: Incident Response, Threat Hunting & Hands-on Labs
days.title: Capstone Project: End-to-End System Hardening & Audit
days.desc: Audit, harden, firewall, and document your personal Linux workstation.
checklist: Audit running services and disable unused network ports
Verify SSH hardening and firewall drop rules
Run a Lynis or rkhunter scan and achieve a hardened baseline

days.phaseName: Incident Response, Threat Hunting & Hands-on Labs
days.title: Final Review & Continuous Learning Routine
days.desc: Establish daily habits: security news (The Hacker News, BleepingComputer), daily terminal practice.
days.cmd: echo 'Congratulations on completing the 90-Day Linux, SysAdmin & CyberSec Roadmap!'
